column3: Secret access stays scoped by permission, not by ref; the exposure of the on-by-default tool-web row to every stored credential is documented in AGENTS.md and 15-web.md instead of fixed
column4: Per-ref scoping is not cheap: tool-web and tool-git read fixed refs a manifest could declare, but mcp-server and deploy-hook read refs named in owner-written config, so a limit needs a new manifest field and a config-derived ref list; rows share the Home isolate, so the facade keeps honest code honest and does not confine hostile code
column5: src/kernel/facade.ts ALLOWED.secrets is { get, set } for any row with the secrets permission; plugins/mcp/server.ts and plugins/deploy-hook/deployhook.ts expand refs from config via src/credentials.ts
column6: documented; per-ref scoping left for its own PR
